about.label: Company
about.title: A reliable partner for engineering system installation and service
about.text: InstaRum s.r.o. specialises in professional installation and maintenance of engineering systems in Czechia. We work with apartments and private houses, commercial facilities, offices, shops, construction companies and contractors. We speak Czech, English, Russian and Ukrainian. We are based in Prague 12 and cover all of Prague and the Central Bohemian Region.

items.title: Installation and connection of plumbing equipment

items.name: Marek Novák
items.text: Full heating system replacement in a two-storey house - new pipes, radiators and boiler. Three days of work and they left the walls spotless. Heating works exactly as it should.

items.name: Jana Svobodová
items.text: A pipe burst behind the boiler on a Saturday evening and water was flooding the kitchen. They arrived within the hour and fixed it. Would give five stars but expected a slightly longer warranty on the repair.

items.name: Olena Kovalchenko
items.text: Heat pump installation. I was worried about the language barrier, but they speak Russian and Ukrainian - no stress at all. Work done cleanly, running without issues since the first winter.

items.name: Tomáš Krejčí
items.text: Old gas boiler swapped for a condensing one. Arrived on time, cleaned up, explained the new controls. Fair price for the market, work done without complaints. Will call again.

items.name: Ivan Sokolov
items.text: New plumbing and drainage in a renovated flat. Four days of work, not a speck of dust left behind. They suggested where to save on materials without cutting corners on what matters.

items.name: Petra Horáčková
items.text: Underfloor heating across the whole flat. Had to relocate one thermostat - the initial position wasn't ideal. Fixed it without any fuss or extra charge. Even heat throughout.

items.name: Andriy Melnyk
items.text: Full central heating on a turnkey basis for a renovated flat. Came with a clear proposal, explained each phase, kept to the schedule. No drips, no pipe knocking.

items.name: Martin Dvořák
items.text: Called them to repair the office boiler. The repair itself was done well. However, they didn't show up on the agreed day and didn't call ahead - came only after rescheduling. Too big a slip for full marks.

items.name: Lukáš Procházka
items.text: Replaced four radiators - three in rooms, one in the bathroom. Bled the old circuit, swapped radiators and thermostatic valves. The whole flat heats evenly now. Neighbours asked who we used.

items.name: Světlana Ivanova
items.text: Stuck valve at 2 am, flat going cold. Technician arrived in 50 minutes and fixed it. Slightly scraped the plaster around the pipe but otherwise completely satisfied. Grateful for the night call.

items.name: Jiří Blaha
items.text: Full bathroom from scratch - new waste pipe, new supply pipes, new mixer tap. Suggested a better layout, took care of everything. Did more than I originally planned and at a fair price.

items.name: Nataliya Bondarenko
items.text: Annual boiler service before winter. Everything checked and adjusted. Staff speak Czech and Russian, pleasant to deal with. One star off only because the service window was shorter than expected.

items.name: Pavel Černý
items.text: They installed our heat pump and we have used their annual service ever since. Every year on time, with a condition report and specific recommendations on what to address before it becomes a problem. That is how service should work.

items.name: Kateryna Shevchenko
items.text: Underfloor heating in the children's room and hallway. Schedule kept, cleaned up to the last speck. One star off - the explanation of the controls was too brief.

items.question: Which areas do you cover?
items.answer: We work in Prague and Středočeský Region. We can also travel to other parts of the Czech Republic on request.

items.question: Do you offer emergency call-out?
items.answer: Yes, we provide 24/7 emergency call-out and urgent repairs for all engineering systems.

items.question: Which languages do you work in?
items.answer: We work in Czech, English, Russian and Ukrainian.

items.question: What types of properties do you work with?
items.answer: We handle apartments, private houses, commercial premises, offices, shops, and projects for construction companies and contractors.

items.question: Why choose InstaRum s.r.o.?
items.answer: Clients choose us for official Czech licences and permits, a professional approach, modern technical solutions, responsibility for the result and respect for deadlines.

items.question: Do you offer a free consultation?
items.answer: Yes, we are happy to advise you on any question free of charge. Contact us by phone or via the contact form.
